department: Graduate School of Chemical and Molecular Sciences Zurich (CMSZH)

deadline.value: No fixed deadline: you apply to a supervisor (PI), who then starts the CMSZH procedure.
deadline.quote: Applications have to be submitted directly to the supervisor (PI) and upon his/her request, the further application procedure will then be handled by the CMSZH.

supervisor.value: Applications go to the supervisor, not to the graduate school.
supervisor.quote: Applications sent directly to the CMSZH will not be considered.

entry_route.value: A Master's degree or equivalent in natural sciences is required.
entry_route.quote: applicants must hold a Master's degree or equivalent in the field of Natural Sciences.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

funding.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Open positions page showed none at time of checking.
